mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT cleanup.id FROM kb_document_object_cleanup cleanup WHERE ( (cleanup.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND cleanup.attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND cleanup.next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (cleanup.status = 'PROCESSING' AND cleanup.attempt_count <= #{maxAttempts} AND cleanup.lease_until <= #{now}) ) ORDER BY coalesce(cleanup.next_attempt_at, cleanup.lease_until), cleanup.observed_at, cleanup.id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE kb_document_object_cleanup cleanup SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = cleanup.attempt_count + 1, next_attempt_at = NULL, lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, failure_code = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, completed_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = cleanup.version + 1 FROM candidate WHERE cleanup.id = candidate.id RETURNING cleanup.*
